words.ex: The price {{BLANK}} went up again this month.

words.c: a mess처럼 관사를 붙여 쓴다. mess up은 망치다.

words.c: mess up은 방을 어지럽히거나 일을 망칠 때 쓴다.

words.ex: She is happy with her new {{BLANK}}.

words.c: 정기적으로 받는 고정 급여. 보통 연봉으로 정하고 월별 등 일정 주기로 지급한다.

words.ex: It's late. {{BLANK}}, we're all tired.

words.ex: His {{BLANK}} friends never helped him at all.

words.ex: What a {{BLANK}} day for a walk!
words.tr: 산책하기 참 좋은 날이다!
words.c: -ly로 끝나지만 형용사다. beautiful보다 편한 칭찬 말.

words.ex: We went {{BLANK}} with my uncle last Sunday.
words.tr: 우리는 지난 일요일에 삼촌이랑 낚시하러 갔어.
words.c: fish+-ing. go fishing처럼 go+-ing 놀이 표현으로 익힌다.

words.ex: I have to write an {{BLANK}} by Friday.

words.ex: The museum shows {{BLANK}} art from many countries.

words.ex: She joined the {{BLANK}} club at school last year.

words.ex: Our class had too much {{BLANK}} this week.

words.ex: My little sister is afraid of {{BLANK}}s.

words.ex: The man went to jail for {{BLANK}}.

words.ex: A {{BLANK}} flew over the school this morning.

words.ex: It was only a {{BLANK}} mistake on the test.

words.ex: This movie is not for {{BLANK}}s.

words.ex: My phone {{BLANK}} died in the middle of class.

words.ex: The pizza {{BLANK}} took almost an hour.
